survival_rule: survives if P >= 0.95 at n=75 and n=72; likely if >= 0.8; otherwise does not survive (fixed before the run)

hierarchy_model: a8_specvar hierarchy on the log target: log y_ck = gamma_cell(k) + alpha_c + s_c + e_ck; s_c ~ N(0, ln(1+CV^2)) fixed; alpha_c ~ N(0, omega^2), omega ~ half-Cauchy(1); statements on exp(alpha_c); V_rms reproduces a8, V_pp and |V|max are an extension

screened_out.reason: Verma 2024 J. Electron. Mater.: the KNNLTS content is varied, not the MWCNT content
Shoorangiz 2022 Ceram. Int.: optimum CNT loading not stated in the abstract, full text not reachable
Liu 2013 Sens. Actuators A: abstract gives no loading optimum, full text not reachable
Wu 2018 Nanomaterials: a single CNT loading
Wang 2018 Nanomaterials: a single MWCNT loading (0.2 wt%)
Eun 2021 Mater. Des.: the abstract reports beta fraction and strength only, full text blocked
Crystals 2023 PVDF-TrFE/MWCNT nanowires: loading choice from unpublished 'stability' results
ACS ANM 2025 BaTiO3/f-MWCNT hybrid: the hybrid filler ratio and loading vary together
Koç 2025 J. Mater. Sci.: source of our own grid, never part of the prior

round2.loading_note: loadings are wt% as reported (relative to the polymer where the paper says so); two papers giving wt% of the spinning solution were converted to wt% of PVDF

curvature.model: ln(y/y*) = -k (log2(c/c*))^2 through the observed optimum, c > 0

prior_definitions.meta_*: optimum location m from the random-effects predictive of that study set; curvature k from the literature curves (Xu2024, Song2022, Attaoui2025; Student-t on log k)
prior_definitions.external_Salama2024: m ~ N(log10 1.95, tau_meta^2) (E4 law argmax), k from the Salama curve with the literature log-k spread
prior_definitions.external_Shi2025: m ~ N(log10 5.08, tau_meta^2) (E4 law argmax), k from the Shi curve with the literature log-k spread
prior_definitions.shape_only: m log-uniform on 0.01-10 wt%, literature k: tests what the curve shape alone adds
prior_definitions.flat: no curve: the five composition effects are flat (data only)
prior_definitions.s_eta: curve misfit sd 0.1 on the log scale (sensitivity 0.05 and 0.20 with meta_primary)

basis_sensitivity.definition: our loadings read as wt% of PVDF (pvdf) or as wt% of total solids with BaTiO3 at 5-20 wt% of the solids (BaTiO3 fraction not documented locally), converted to wt% of PVDF by c / (1 - b - c); the literature optima stay as recorded in the csv

model_names.re-draw: a8 specimen re-draw of the observed composition means (specimen effect only, recording noise ignored); round 1, key redraw
model_names.hierarchical (exchangeable): a8 Gibbs hierarchy, alpha_c ~ N(0, omega^2), half-Cauchy omega; round 1, key hierarchy; the paper's primary numbers
model_names.hierarchical (flat): round-2 Gaussian model with flat composition effects (recording noise and specimen variance); key round2.posterior.*.flat
model_names.hierarchical (curve prior): round-2 Gaussian model with the literature curve prior on the CNT compositions; key round2.posterior.*.meta_* / external_* / shape_only
